name: Sorauta
source:
The main character lost his parents when he was a kid and currently lives at his aunt's house. Tamako, his aunt's daughter, takes care of him well and they live a peaceful life. She also knows he can see ghosts.... He is now on summer holiday and enjoys it with Tamako, Chika, his old friend, and Aoi, his friend. But one day, Tamako suddenly leaves her house.... He doesn't know why, but she never comes back. Several days later, he meets a ghost. It is Mana, who jumped off a school building and died....

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/4748]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公幼年丧亲，如今寄住在姑母家中。表姐灵子对他悉心照料，姐弟俩过着平静的日常生活——而灵子也知晓他拥有能看见幽灵的特殊体质……眼下正值暑假，主人公与灵子、青梅竹马知夏以及好友葵一同享受着惬意的假期。不料某天，灵子竟毫无征兆地离家出走，从此杳无音信……数日后，主人公邂逅了一缕幽魂——那正是此前从教学楼纵身跃下身亡的少女真奈……

[译自[url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/4748]Himeya Shop[/url]]
